summary: Lufax filed a Form 6-K announcing board and management changes via a press release dated July 24, 2026. Four directors, including CFO Tongzhuan Xi, resigned effective July 25, 2026, citing personal work arrangements, with no disagreements. The company retained an existing CEO as authorized representative and appointed an independent non-executive director. A CFO search is ongoing with internal transition coverage. No transaction terms, premium, or shareholder vote is involved. This is a non-routine forced leadership departure, not a routine meeting circular. The stock remains suspended on HKEX; monitor CFO appointment and trading resumption updates.
